items.title: Kering H1 2026 results: Gucci Asia-Pacific shows early recovery signs but region still negative
items.summary: Kering's official H1 2026 results release states Gucci's Asia-Pacific comparable sales improved sequentially in Q2 (from -8% in Q1) but remained negative for the half, with Mainland China still 'challenging' even as APAC showed 'early signs of recovery' alongside Western Europe. CEO Luca de Meo said new collections are 'driving stronger brand visibility, renewed client engagement and positive retail trends.' Directly operated retail sales fell 6% comparable for H1.

items.title: Gucci Q2 beat sparks Kering share rally, but 12th straight quarterly sales drop and 100-store closure plan continue
items.summary: Gucci's Q2 organic revenue fell 2%, its twelfth consecutive quarterly decline, but beat analyst forecasts, sending Kering shares up 11.8% (best day since Jan 2025). The article confirms Kering will still close 100 stores by year-end and cut group inventory by ~1 billion euros under CEO Luca de Meo's turnaround plan; growth was driven mainly by US handbag demand rather than Asia. HSBC called it the group 'focusing on the right priorities.'

items.title: Malaysian Threads user asks why Gucci KLCC (Suria KLCC, Kuala Lumpur) closed
items.summary: A Malay-language Threads post simply asking 'Kenapa Gucci KLCC tutup' (why did Gucci KLCC close) drew notable organic engagement, reflecting public surprise/concern over the flagship's closure. Retained despite being outside the ideal 7-day window because it is the most substantive SEA-specific critical-angle signal found and anchors an ongoing discussion thread (see companion items); flagged here as aged (44 days) rather than treated as fresh.

items.title: Commentary thread: KLCC losing status as default luxury address after Gucci and other brand closures
items.summary: A follow-up Threads commentary post argues Gucci's KLCC exit is part of a broader pattern where Kuala Lumpur's KLCC mall is 'no longer automatically the default prestige option' for luxury brands evaluating Malaysian market entry, citing other closures (Dior Men, Bottega Veneta, Berluti) alongside Gucci. Low engagement on this specific post but reflects an emerging critical narrative about Gucci's Malaysia retail footprint. Also aged (43 days); retained for the same reason as the companion item above.

items.title: Lowyat.net (Malaysian tech/lifestyle forum) thread: 'Gucci KLCC permanently closed'
items.summary: A community discussion thread on Malaysia's largest general forum debates why Gucci permanently closed its Suria KLCC boutique, with posters attributing it to rental costs misaligned with the mall's premium positioning and pointing to a wider pattern of luxury tenant departures (Dior Men, Bottega Veneta, Berluti) from KLCC. Page could not be fully fetched (HTTP 403) so full thread content/engagement counts are unverified beyond the thread's existence and topic; date is an estimate based on when the topic surfaced in search indexing.
